title: Pentecost - The Coming of the Spirit
introduction: Pentecost marks the coming of the Holy Spirit upon the church. Jesus had promised that he would not leave his disciples as orphans. The Spirit came with power, and God's people were equipped to be witnesses for Jesus to the ends of the earth.

sections.title: The Promise of the Spirit
sections.description: Jesus promised that the Spirit would come after his ascension.

sections.title: Pentecost Day
sections.description: The Spirit fell upon the 120 gathered in Jerusalem with power.

sections.title: Peter's Pentecost Sermon
sections.description: Peter preached the gospel with boldness, and thousands were saved.

sections.title: Fulfillment of Prophecy
sections.description: Joel had prophesied that God would pour out his Spirit on all flesh.

sections.title: The Spirit Today
sections.description: The gift of Pentecost is for everyone who calls on the name of the Lord.
